1879061016.name: Trick: Enrage
1879061016.desc: Cause the enemy to take more damage and prevent them from using most ranged attacks.\n\nLimit: One Trick per target.

procEffects.description: DNT - Grants the Burglar a crit response effect

1879072536.name: Lie In Wait
1879072536.desc: When not in combat, you can hide beneath the ground, unseen by foes, until you burst from the ground.

1879094936.name: Timeless Echoes of Battle
1879094936.desc: This powerful chant recalls great deeds done in battle by the mighty Valar when the world was young, demoralizing your foes.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>This skill must target an enemy and is only usable in Dissonance.</rgb>

1879097880.name: Charge!
1879097880.desc: When the time comes to enter the fray it falls to the Orcs to break battle lines. Your speed increases for a brief period of time. You gain a short immunity to incoming root, stun and daze effects. This skill can only be used while out of combat.

1879115160.name: Dark Inspirtation
1879115160.desc: Increases in and out of combat power regeneration.

1879115288.name: Weighted Arrow
1879115288.desc: A shaft aimed to slow the movement of your quarry.

1879132056.name: Muster in Esteldín
1879132056.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Esteldín in the North Downs.

1879134360.name: Spear and Fist
1879134360.desc: Mastery over the Spear: Allows the Warden to perform Spear Gambits quickly.

1879139736.name: Catch Prey
1879139736.desc:
You fling a fine mesh of gossamer silk at your target, giving you a small advantage in manoeuvrability.<rgb=#00ff00>
 
 Steals Block, Parry, and Evade from your target every 2s, while reducing their melee defences.

Applies Ensnared Effect. 
 Stacks 3 times. 
 </rgb>

1879157400.name: Quick Sweep
1879157400.desc: A weak AOE strike that is used often

1879158168.name: Wing Buffet
1879158168.desc: Flapping your wings at an enemy can push them backwards, gaining you more time to flee. Can only be used against monster player targets.

1879186712.name: Improved Dazing Blow
1879186712.desc: Dazes the enemy with a pair of melee attacks while dual-wielding.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Daze replaced with a debuff that reduces damage against dismounted players.</rgb>

1879209880.name: Steed of the Captain
1879209880.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the captain.

1879215256.name: Improved Sign of the Wild: Rage
1879215256.desc: Enables animal companion to attack faster, deal more damage, and draw threat.\n\nOnly one Sign of the Wild may be active without the trait: Master of Beasts.

1879229976.name: Yule Festival Snowy Horse
1879229976.desc: A horse from the Yule Festival.

1879239576.name: Noble Arrow
1879239576.desc: The Noble Arrow, once launched, will seek to injure your foe with critical intent.

1879252888.name: War-steed: Heavy
1879252888.desc: The Destrier is a heavily armoured War-steed. Stalwart and imposing, The Destrier is bred for battle. The least agile and slowest of the war-steeds trades speed and maneuverability.

1879260056.name: Improved Swift Bow: Ablaze
1879260056.desc: Loose three missiles in rapid succession.\n\nArrows inflict fire damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Swift Bow has a chance to make Merciful Shot available.

1879260312.name: Burglar's Treat
1879260312.desc: A Burglar is not always about tricks. Sometimes a treat is in order.\n\nThis skill gives you and your allies a temporary buff.

1879270552.name: Enraging Shot
1879270552.desc: A short range attack that will briefly enrage the target.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879314840.name: Muster in Dol Amroth
1879314840.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Dol Amroth in western Gondor.

1879391384.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Elvish Soldier)
1879391384.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879457560.name: Javelin of Fate
1879457560.desc: A lunge which deals shorter, more potent Light damage over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879466264.name: Feint
1879466264.desc:
Fool your opponent by rapidly stopping your previous movement, allowing you to take a different tack.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:</rgb><rgb=#FF0000>
 Dodge restores morale.
 Cut-over becomes AoE.
 Compound Attack has increased critical chance.</rgb>

1879467288.name: Rummage: Scrap of Music
1879467288.desc: A scrap of an ancient tune.

conditionalEffects.description: Shanties will restore the morale of affected allies.

1879475992.name: Guide to Umbar
1879475992.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Umbar Baharbêl.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879483160.name: Explosive Arrow
1879483160.desc: Fires an explosive arrow at the targetted area.\n\nAll enemies that come in contact with the brief but intense blaze will take fire damage.

1879485336.name: Sienna Hamster
1879485336.desc: Summons an adorable hamster to keep you company.

1879488024.name: Friend of Small Fowl (Amethyst-tailed Caller)
1879488024.desc: Summons a raven-type companion.\n\nThe amethyst-tailed caller specializes in buffing and debuffing.

1879509912.name: Acidic Sheath
1879509912.desc: Surround yourself in an acidic sheen. Those foolish enough to strike you with weapons will see them corrode and weaken.
